goals.description: Bin Archon of Cruelty: Faithless Looting, Thought Scour, Psychic Frog discard, or a hand attack aimed at our own hand
Reanimate Archon of Cruelty with Persist (or Emperor of Bones from any graveyard)
Attack with Archon, Oculus and Frogs; Fatal Push clears blockers

_mulligan_min_lands_doc: 2026-11-10: 1 -> 2. Goldfish n=60 paired (s70000): floor 2 moves the median go-off turn one turn earlier (Goryo's 6 -> 5, Grixis Reanimator 5 -> 4) and the mean kill turn down (8.93 -> 8.62, 6.68 -> 6.42). A 1-land seven with no card that finds a land stalls: Storm's 1-land keeps went off at 8.5 against 6 for two or more lands. Decks whose cheap cards find lands (Living End's cyclers) and Storm were measured and are not changed.
